from pathlib import Path
import zlib
raw=Path('corpus_hard.txt').read_bytes(); packed=Path('out.bin').read_bytes()
assert raw == Path('restored.txt').read_bytes()
assert len(packed) < len(zlib.compress(raw))
print('Exact round trip; compressed:',len(packed),'default zlib:',len(zlib.compress(raw)),'reduction:',100*(1-len(packed)/len(raw)))
PY
